item.title: [IGNITE-1003] Communication issues when running client node in separate subnetwork
item.description:
Test is the following:

  • Run 8 server nodes on one box.
  • Start and stop client node in a loop on a different box in different subnetwork (e.g., over VPN).

On one if iterations node join process will hang for several minutes due to timeouts in initial partition exchange. At some point communication between some of the server nodes stops working - messages wait in queue until connection is closed and these messages are recovered.

Attached are configuration file used to run the test and logs with communication debug enabled.
item.summary: Communication issues when running client node in separate subnetwork

status.description: A resolution has been taken, and it is awaiting verification by reporter. From here issues are either reopened, or are closed.

Here nio worker hangs in tryFailNode() so communication IO is blocked, need to move tryFailNode from nio worker.

Valentin, recently I've fixed a bug when start and stop of multiple clients from multiple threads caused hanging and a memory leak.
What you're talking about is similar to what I observed while was fixing that bug.

In any case I tested the following:

  • 8 servers in one subnetwork and client (in other subnetwork) start and stop;
  • 8 servers in one subnetwork and 5 clients (in other subnetwork) start and stop from multiple threads;

I've been runnning the tests for 10 minutes. Client nodes were running in VirtualBox.

Please, double check everything in your original environment using the latest sources from the master branch.
